item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 02
item.description:
60 development commits

Sailing

  • Sail wind behavior is now fully server‑side, eliminating client/server mismatches and ensuring consistent wind effects on sailboats.

Livestock & Animals

  • Livestock breeding rebalanced: bond time increased to 15 min, reproduction blocked until full bond, population capped at 300 per species, new "livestock.cullexcess" command to cull excess, and "livestock.breedOnlyAtHome" convar to restrict breeding near a player’s TC.
  • Cows no longer unfreeze their needs or age incorrectly when bonded, fixing livestock stat inconsistencies.

Deployables

  • Halloween string lights are now deployable again.

Server & Stability

  • Modded servers are now correctly tagged and will no longer crash before fully starting.

World & Environment

  • Water now correctly appears in underground and underwater lab areas, restoring expected water physics and visual cues.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Oct 01
item.description:
85 development commits

Controls & UI

  • Input reliability improvements: Steam input startup issue fixed and gamepad cursor handling corrected.
  • Quick‑join menu now reflects changes instantly, and sleeping bag placement range indicator updates for all players when the range setting changes.

Inventory & Crafting

  • Water jug re‑added to Items, making it recyclable and storable in fridges/minifridges; biofuel generator placement no longer snaps backwards; crash when loading code‑locks resolved.

Livestock & AI

  • Livestock no longer attack players in vehicles and are safe from damage inside safe zones; AI overhauled: bulls stop unreachable headbutts, rams aim and animate headbutts correctly with procedural look‑at, clipping reduced when leading groups and at troughs, and a fix reduces unexpected cow sliding.

Weapons

  • Rifles now maintain correct orientation while sprinting and receive a sprint speed boost for specific models (med, jungle, diver AKs); minicrossbow reload animation now plays partial reload in third‑person as intended.

New Content & Environment

  • Electronic chessboard added as a deployable interactive item; jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, restoring normal water levels for terrain‑placed flora.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Lambs and calves no longer block travelling vendors, keeping vendor stalls clear for players.
